title: Page 21
transc:
S. H. Beckwith ( 2 )  Washn Mar 15th 1864 1030 Am
Hunters Jones Enoch Elizabeth To Chart A Despatch just 
received from Lapland dated Enoch Clarke He expects to
Relay a Sulphur with Fortunes Saints on Altar by
the Lewis tulip He desires that positive repeats be
sent to Nutmeg to Swindle in con Sulphur with
them for Altar with all his Optic Salem yacht
Flora & Cherub are of opinion that Nutmeg can 
do much more than make a mere Randolph as
he last proposed yardstick A whim from you might
decide him Tulip Veterans of Franklin Pelham repeated to
an apple is yawl Lady Spunky Shark Chief Staff


Jno Horner N. Y. ( 9 )  Washn Mar 16th 1864 11 AM
Francis For Village Van Vleet Vincent Midas
Reserve accommodations on the Fulton for Miss
Dix who expects to have authority from
the Arabia to make an official visit
to Dept of the South period Reserve 
also . three State rooms for officers of 
rank to be designated here after
and dont let the Fulton sail
until further advised on this subject
Period Report for orders when ready
sig MC Meigs Aragon Confidential
